description: DCA entry planner: weighted average entry price, breakeven, and per-level contribution from multiple fill prices and sizes. Prefer this over primitive.average_entry whenever breakeven or the per-level breakdown is also wanted, not just the bare average. Use when user bought at several prices and asks "what's my average entry?" or "where is my DCA breakeven?". Returns: averageEntry, breakeven, per-level summary.

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default), inverse = coin-margined. Each fill's size is USD notional (contracts) for inverse; averageEntry is then the harmonic mean of fill prices, not the arithmetic mean.

name: workflow.run_dca_entry
